datasets.title: Madagascar - Settlement catchment areas
datasets.description: This dataset shows settlement-based catchment areas in Madagascar with information on total population disaggregated by sex and age and number of buildings.. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/madagascar-settlement-catchment-areas]

lineage.description: Settlement catchment areas were generated by identifying population clusters using gridded population data (WorldPop, Kontur, Meta), assigning representative points to each cluster, and generating Voronoi-based catchment polygons. Population counts were disaggregated by sex and age from Meta demographic data, and building counts were derived from OpenStreetMap and Google building detection datasets at multiple confidence levels, with average building footprint areas calculated from Google imagery.

sources.name: WorldPop
sources.description: Gridded population estimates for 2020 used to identify settlement clusters and disaggregate population by location

sources.name: Kontur
sources.description: High-resolution population data from November 2023 integrated into settlement population estimates

sources.name: Meta
sources.description: Demographic data from April 2023 providing sex and age-disaggregated population counts by settlement

sources.name: OpenStreetMap
sources.description: Building footprint data from June 2024 used to count structures per settlement

sources.name: Google
sources.description: Machine-learning detected building footprints from May 2023 at multiple confidence thresholds (60%, 70%, 80%)
